catalogPolicy.rule: Do not increase the core public SKU count when approving ordinary third-party products. Every new ordinary product should replace a weaker current product or fill a currently empty strategic department with a deliberate corresponding demotion.
exceptions: A genuinely differentiated WYX-exclusive or private-label product
A category-defining product that fills an empty strategic department such as footwear, bags or golf tech
